provenance.normal_hit_points: CUSTOM_BALANCE: native per-hit conversion not found; 10000 raw points gives approximately 1056 confirmed hits to the first one-handed-sword level. Only ordinary hits with an equipped mapped weapon count.
provenance.purchase_day: CUSTOM_BALANCE: native Daily schedule and shared five-use cap are confirmed; exact native reset hour is unknown. This local game uses 05:00 at fixed UTC+09:00. Clock rollback never grants a new period.
provenance.acquire_cost: CUSTOM_BALANCE: level-up option acquisition is confirmed; an explicit initial acquisition price was not found. Local default is zero Adena. Reroll fees remain the original source amounts.
provenance.color_draw_mode: CUSTOM_BALANCE: original grade weights and four name/value fields are confirmed; native statistical independence is not. Default independent_fields draws once per unlocked field; optional shared_level uses one grade draw for all unlocked fields of that level. Both use original grade weights. Neither is claimed native-equivalent.
provenance.point_only_target_options: CUSTOM_BEHAVIOR: original notices establish point summation, source reset and no extra option fee, but do not explicitly define an existing destination's options when no levels are selected. Default preserve_existing retains destination groups, colors and locks. clear_existing explicitly clears them; block_unverified keeps the conservative guard. Selected policy is shown before confirmation and recorded in the receipt. Source fields and confirmed costs are unchanged.
provenance.typed_percent_ignore: CUSTOM_BEHAVIOR: native typed reduction-ignore formula was not found in original523, handoff report or official public search. Reuse TWILIGHT's existing percent-ignore -> damage-amplifier consumer, restricting mastery to the source melee/ranged/magic kind. Existing rounding and 0..300 percent total amplification cap are unchanged. display_only disables only this inferred effect. PvP numeric and flat-ignore conversion follow established single-player rules, not this setting.
provenance.partial_repair: CUSTOM_BEHAVIOR: explicit confirmation restores only an absent unique100%-source option in an already partly owned level with four preserved colors and another existing option. Never reroll or infer variable values, colors, locks or whole empty levels. preview_only disables writes. Backup and receipt preserve provenance; invalid saves remain protected.
provenance.partial_repair_cost: CUSTOM_BALANCE: local compatibility repair has no original price; default0 Adena, configurable. Existing purchase/reset/change fees unchanged.
provenance.partial_reroll: CUSTOM_BEHAVIOR: complete_levels_only rerolls complete owned levels while preserving partial levels byte-equivalent in meaning. Fee uses the original row for locks on the changed scope. block_weapon restores strict legacy behavior. Unknown missing fields are never drawn.
provenance.reset_payment_default: CUSTOM_UI_POLICY: default currency preserves existing behavior; ticket selects only the original TicketAmount and Currency1814. No automatic fallback or mixed payment. Currency definition BM is shown using host common rarity; original grade remains in the private definition. Only source-proven normal physical tickets qualify; name-only legacy stacks and unconfirmed bless variants are preserved.
